'''Crysfangs''', were a hostile, [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] subspecies of [[Mawvorr]], native to [[Voss]]. The creatures were primarily found in the [[Old Paths]] and the [[Nightmare Lands]], where they were especially abundant in the [[Flamewood]] and [[Crysfang Glade]] areas respectively. Being the most common species of mawvorrs, crysfangs were sometimes referred to simply as "mawvorrs" without specification.<ref name="Voss">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Voss]]}}</ref>

Crysfangs had pink skin while their eyes and chromatophore plates were glowing blue.<ref name="crysfang" /> Though mostly carnivorous,<ref name="codex" /> they also loved fruits such as [[Muja fruit/Legends|Muja fruit]]. Crysfangs could be trained by a skilled handler and accompany their masters outside their natural habitat.<ref name="companion">{{TORcite|type=other|Mawvorr Companion}}</ref>

==History==
Crysfangs stalked the wilderness outside [[Voss-Ka]], and were generally considered opportunistic. Being careful hunters preferring to strike already wounded prey, in packs they exhibited increased aggression and have been known to attack even the mighty [[vorantikus]].<ref name="codex" />

The creatures were known to typically attack [[Gormak/Legends|Gormak]] on sight, though they did not eat their bodies afterwards. This odd behavior has led the [[Voss (species)|Voss]] to perceive crysfangs as guardians or protectors who abhor the Gormak. Because of this, the Voss took steps to maintain the crysgang population around Voss-Ka. This symbiotic relationship could be taken to extremes during the times of low food supply for crysfangs; there was a historical account of a [[Voss Mystics|Mystic's]] vision resulting in unarmed Voss wandering out into the wilderness and allowing themselves to be devoured by crysfang packs.<ref name="codex" />
